name: merged-table-customer-profiles
title: Preserve and display customer profiles on merged tables
description: Keep customer records attached to their source tables, expose a grouped query for merged tables, and display every customer profile without overwriting one another.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: A merged table is a new Table record while customer rows remain attached to hidden source tables. The current singular tableCustomer query therefore returns null for the merged table. The fix adds a grouped, source-aware query and keeps the existing singular contract for compatibility. Active orders and reservations remain protected from merge; occupied tables without an active order/reservation may merge and produce an occupied composite.
